definitions.keep_rate: kept/(kept+lost) over items the base answered correctly
definitions.fix_rate: fixed/(fixed+missed) over items the base answered wrongly
definitions.inherit_gap: keep_rate - fix_rate (0 if the run's correctness is independent of the base's)
definitions.mcnemar: exact two-sided on lost vs fixed; Holm across all plain-reference run pairs
definitions.fisher: two-sided Fisher exact on the 2x2 (dependence of run correctness on base correctness)

classes.shortcut: not constant; best surface-rule kappa >= 0.3 and > kappa(truth)

definitions.weak_base: base accuracy < 0.65 (base-correct items include lucky guesses)
